en: The Dhāraṇī Sūtra for Eliminating All Diseases.

[Posthumous Title of the Translator: Grand Master of the Household, Acting Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial, Duke of Sushan with a fief of three thousand households, conferred the purple robe, posthumously appointed as Minister of Works, with the posthumous title Dajian (Great Mirror).
Thus have I heard. At one time, the Bhagavat... [translated by the Tripiṭaka Śramaṇa Amoghavajra of the Great Xingshan Temple, who bears the title of Great and Vast Wisdom, by imperial decree].
He was dwelling in the city of Śrāvastī, in the Jeta Grove, the park of the householder Anāthapiṇḍada,
together with a great assembly of one thousand two hundred and fifty bhikṣus,
and a multitude of many great bodhisattva-mahāsattvas.
At that time, the World-Honored One addressed Ānanda, saying:
"Ānanda, there is a dhāraṇī capable of eliminating all diseases in the world."
"You should receive, uphold, recite, master, and apply it correctly through proper mental attention.
Then he spoke these secret words:
*Tadyathā | vimale vimale | vanakucire | śrīmatī | guṇare | nenuṣi | indra-iṇi | mule svāhā*. The Buddha said to Ānanda:
If anyone recites and maintains this dhāraṇī,
[it will cure] indigestion, chronic vomiting, disorders of wind, bile, and phlegm, as well as hemorrhoids,
fistulas, urinary ailments, and upward-moving qi.
Those suffering from coughing, pestilence, chills, fever, headaches, or partial facial paralysis,
as well as those possessed by malevolent spirits, shall all be completely cured.
With my Buddha-eye, I behold such persons.
Devas, Māras, Brahmās, śramaṇas, and brāhmaṇas may create obstacles and difficulties; however,
except for those cases where determined karmic retribution must be exhausted,
none others can transgress or create such obstacles and difficulties.
The Tathāgata, the Arhat, the Samyaksaṃbuddha has declared:
"Among all sentient beings, the Tathāgata is the most honored and supreme;
among all phenomena, the phenomenon of detachment from desire is the most honored."
Among all assemblies, the Saṅgha is the most venerable.
By this word of truth, may I and all sentient beings find perfect peace and well-being as we eat,
drink, chew, and swallow, and as these things enter our stomachs and are digested.
*Svāhā*. At that time,
when the Blessed One had finished speaking this sutra,
the assembly of bhikṣus, along with all the bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, [received it with joy].
The entire assembly— the devas, nāgas, and the eight classes of supernatural beings—
received and upheld the Buddha’s words, rejoicing and practicing them accordingly.
*The Dhāraṇī Sūtra for Eliminating All Diseases*.
